[#TBKgao (label)] Room To Room by Tobokegao [TBK-009] OUT NOW! #chiptune

https://tbkgao.bandcamp.com/album/room-to-room
https://tbkgao.bandcamp.com/album/room-to-room

COVID-19によって変動した死生観から逃避することをコンセプトにgameboyで制作された2nd full albumです…！
BONUS: LSDj 8.9.6 sav data

artwork: toyoya @toyoya8

1334771578865811466.t:
For the artwork, I asked my favorite pixel artist toyoya to draw two rooms (a bright room and a dark room) in pixel art on one artwork.

artworkは、大好きなpixel artistのtoyoyaさんにお願いして、1つのartworkに2つの部屋（明るい部屋と暗い部屋）をpixelartで描いてもらいました。

1334773326221209600.t:
Because in COVID-19, the more people in a room, the more you have to be aware of death when moving from room to room, and I wanted to immerse myself in the music even in such situations

https://x.com/to6okegao/status/1334769410523873281?s=19

1334773439693877248.t:
というのも、COVID-19では部屋の中にいる人数が多いほど、部屋から部屋へ移動する際に死を意識しなければならないので、そんな状況でも音楽に没頭したいと思ったからです。
https://x.com/to6okegao/status/1334773326221209600?s=19

1334773849750085634.t:
I also wanted to be able to express the feeling of being alive and dead in two rooms

あとは、2つの部屋の中で生きているときと死んでいるときの感覚を表現できるようにしたかったからです。
https://x.com/to6okegao/status/1334771578865811466?s=19

1334774959927746561.t:
And since I alternated between sunny and not-so-sunny rooms in my home to make this album, I thought the album artwork and title would be a good fit

Room To Room by Tobokegao | TBKgao https://tbkgao.bandcamp.com/album/room-to-room
https://tbkgao.bandcamp.com/album/room-to-room
